name: vehicle-motion-cues
title: Vehicle Motion Cues
description: Toggle Apple's built-in Vehicle Motion Cues on supported Mac laptops without opening System Settings.
author: yashazare

commands.name: toggle-motion-cues
commands.title: Toggle Vehicle Motion Cues
commands.description: Switch Apple's built-in Vehicle Motion Cues on or off.

commands.name: turn-on-motion-cues
commands.title: Turn on Vehicle Motion Cues
commands.description: Turn on Apple's built-in Vehicle Motion Cues.

commands.name: turn-off-motion-cues
commands.title: Turn off Vehicle Motion Cues
commands.description: Turn off Apple's built-in Vehicle Motion Cues.
